nom: Tanologist Super Shield Face Mist SPF 50

segments.oily: Reactions are split: some oily-skin reviewers call it a greasy mess that looks worse than expected, while others (including one who is oily and acne-prone) say it doesn't disrupt makeup or add shine, with one suggesting blotting first if skin is very oily.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally like the dewy, hydrated finish and lack of white cast, though one mentions experiencing some peeling after use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive eyes report no stinging or irritation from the mist, though this contrasts with other reviewers (skin type unspecified) who did experience eye stinging.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe a hydrating, dewy finish that leaves skin feeling refreshed rather than dried out.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes it doesn't cause breakouts despite having acne, and another says it doesn't worsen acne, but a third reviewer states it clearly caused pimples to appear and clogged pores for them.
concerns.blemishes: Most who mention acne-prone skin report no new breakouts or clogged pores, but one explicitly warns it made pimples appear and clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily-skin reviewers found it left a greasy, shiny finish that worsened their oiliness, while others with oily skin say it did not feel greasy or disrupt their matte look.

extraits.texte: This is a greasy mess. I had a completely matte makeup look but after spraying this I looked UBER greasy/oily. I can only imagine how my naturally oily skin would look hours later after applying this. Also, I saw a review that said it dries down???? Not accurate. I didnt give it 0 stars because it just isn't for me or my skin type. Maybe someone out there likes to look like a grease bucket.

Gifted by Tanologist. Honest review. Since incorporating the SPF 50 Face Mist into my routine, reapplying sunscreen throughout the day has become effortless. As someone with dry skin, I appreciate the dewy finish it leaves behind. I did experience a bit of peeling, but I believe I can minimize that by adjusting my skincare routine.

I received this product for free was gifted by tanologisttan Definitely a very good mist to retouch your spf on the go! Is right now on my purse! Doesn't erase my makeup during the day so is perfect for me. My skin is oily skin so is very good for it! I also have acne and that product doesn't cause me breakouts

Gifted by tanalogist. This is a really good sunscreen. I'm ngl if you are acne prone it WILL make pimples appear and clog your pores unfortunately. It did that for me. Other than that I think it's great and convenient! Has ur typical sunscreen spray feel, just not as greasy.

I love how easy it is to apply since it is a mist. It makes reapplying sunscreen so simple, especially when I already have makeup on. The formula feels lightweight on my skin and it does not leave any greasy feeling or strong sunscreen smell. It also does not irritate my eyes, which is something I usually struggle with when it comes to SPF. The mist is fairly fine, but you do have to spray it a little closer to the face to make sure the product actually lands on the skin instead of floating away. It gives a natural, slightly dewy finish which works well for me, but someone with very oily skin may want to blot before using it. gifted by tanologisttan

* gifted by tanogisttan * I use sunscreen every single day, but I'm not very good with reapplying and that's mostly because I wear makeup. This sunscreen spray not only makes it easy to get an additional sun protection in general, but it's also very helpful if I want to reapply sunscreen during the day. The mist is very fine and doesn't leave water droplets on my face. It smells sweet and reminds me of tropical vacation. It doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell and they really appreciate that. I have sensitive eyes, but have no issues using this mist.

I think maybe this product has so many great reviews because they were gifted/ sponsored, but to give you a heads-up, the fragrance is very strong. It's a kinda yummy and fruity smell, but gets old very fast, is incredibly strong, doesn't fade, and doesn't go away completely after a double cleanse. Ended up stinging the eyes too. Good luck out there finding a good face spf spray, still on the lookout myself.
